value.title: Each Battlefield
value.synopsis: Japan explains the true nature of a ninja's shuriken. Wartime leaves the Axis with a lack of coffee, and Germany is assigned to come up with an alternative.

value.title: Gakuen Hetalia: Go Forth! Newspaper Club!! (Part One)
value.synopsis: The Newspaper Club, which consists of Germany, Italy, and Japan decide to interview all of the clubs in the school.

value.title: Gakuen Hetalia: Go Forth! Newspaper Club!! (Part Two)
value.synopsis: The Newspaper Club goes on to interview the Nordic Club, the Canada Club, the Elephant Appreciation Club, the Music Club, the Swim Team, and the ... "Going Home" club...?

value.title: Russia and Friends
value.synopsis: Little Russia is picked on by Mongolia, Denmark, and Sweden; is freaked out by Little Ukraine, is rejected by a hamster, and fights the Battle on the Ice against the Teutonic Order (Prussia).

value.title: Though I May Depart, You Shall Remain
value.synopsis: After meeting France, a Parisian mortal ponders what it means to live forever.

value.title: Romano's Diary
value.synopsis: In which Chibi Romano is a cute tsundere who really does care for Spain (even though he has an odd way of showing it).

value.title: Things that Often Happen When Rooming with an American
value.synopsis: Japan stays over at America's place for a while. Extreme culture-conflict ensues.

value.title: The Gentle Fight Between Russia and I
value.synopsis: Estonia finds all his websites hacked with each site displaying a drawing of Chibirussia. Immediately, Estonia accuses Russia of the dirty deed, but naturally Russia denies it. In order to solve the mystery, Estonia hires America to trace the hack.

value.title: At Netherlands
value.synopsis: The reasoning behind Netherlands being so obsessively concerned over money is revealed.

value.title: "Turkey&!"
value.synopsis: Greece's philosophical side makes an appearance, and more is revealed about his strange relationship with Turkey. Meanwhile, Italy and Turkey discuss the times when Chibitalia used to beat up Turkey, much to the surprise and disbelief of Germany.

value.title: Our Failure
value.synopsis: All of the countries are threatened with embarrassing photos to come to an April Fool's gathering in even more embarrassing costumes.

value.title: Merry Halloween!
value.synopsis: It's Halloween night, and America wants Japan to help him finally win a Halloween prank war against the undefeated England.

value.title: Finding Santa
value.synopsis: Santa's missing and Finland is in a crisis. So he pleads for the other nations to spread the holiday cheer this Christmas until Santa can be found.

value.title: Brother, we are...!!
value.synopsis: The countries are rated by how fast they walk. Prussia and Germany infiltrate an American camp, and are caught doing so.

value.title: A bientôt! Until We Meet Again!
value.synopsis: France meets a girl and takes her on a tour. They discuss the Hundred Years War, Joan of Arc, and what she means to France.

value.title: What Italy Forgot
value.synopsis: England tells Seychelles that the Prince of England and his wife are going to her place for their honeymoon, but she must keep it secret. And during WWI, Italy forgets his gun, which is later found by Germany.

value.title: Hetalia of the Dead (Part One)
value.synopsis: The axis and allies as well as others watch and discuss horror films from their countries.

value.title: Hetalia of the Dead (Part Two)
value.synopsis: The countries watch more horror films, and realize that horror films from other countries are weird. New Zealand makes his first appearance.

value.title: Keep on moving!! March Forward, Sealand!
value.synopsis: Sealand tries to make a new friend: the newest micro-nation, Wy.

value.title: It's the First Anniversary! The Tripartite Pact
value.synopsis: The Axis Powers celebrate the first year anniversary of the Tripartite Pact.
